title: Declare wagon features as an array of feature URN objects

facts.note: Applies to every wagon manifest artifact, whether newly authored, edited, or existing and unchanged. The source supplies no path glob; recognising a wagon manifest relies on the repository's plan-layout classification (if none exists, this needs a manifest classifier). No operation or diff gate: the format contract describes the current state of every wagon.
State-level (not diff-level) observer that parses a wagon manifest and reports that a `features` key is present and whether its value is an array (urn_format) or a mapping (legacy_format).

fires: Planner authors a new wagon manifest that declares features
Planner edits an existing wagon manifest's features list
An existing, unchanged wagon manifest still declares features as the deprecated legacy object map (name -> description)
A plan/validation pass inspects wagon manifests in the repository, including ones not touched by the current task
doesNotFire: Editing feature files themselves when no wagon manifest declares features in the inspected scope
Non-wagon artifacts (WMBTs, acceptances, docs) that do not declare wagon features
A wagon manifest that has no `features` declaration at all

given: A wagon manifest declares its features (new, edited, or already existing).
when: The planner authors, edits, reviews or validates that wagon's `features` declaration.
then: Declare the wagon's `features` as an array of objects each with a `urn` of the form `feature:{wagon-slug}:{feature-name}`; the legacy object map form is deprecated.
prefer: Write features as `[{urn: feature:{wagon-slug}:{feature-name}}, ...]`, using this wagon's own slug as the middle segment.
When already editing a wagon's features that still use the deprecated legacy object map, consider migrating it to the URN array format (recommendation only; the source sets no migration deadline).
avoid: Introducing the deprecated legacy object map form `{feature-name: 'description'}` for the features declaration.
Bare strings or objects without a `urn` key in the features array.
why: The features declaration shape is a shared contract: the features-manifest rule and tooling consume the URN-array format, which keeps wagon-to-feature references traceable; the object map is the deprecated predecessor.
evidence: Each wagon manifest's `features` value in urn_format is an array whose every element is an object with a `urn` matching `feature:{wagon-slug}:{feature-name}`.
Any wagon manifest whose `features` is an object map is reported as using the deprecated legacy_format (deprecation notice), distinct from a malformed urn_format declaration.
verifier_detail: Term `features_format` = the features declaration shape. Values: urn_format = array of {urn: feature:{wagon-slug}:{feature-name}}; legacy_format = object map (deprecated).
Source example of urn_format: [{urn: feature:maintain-ux:provide-foundations}, {urn: feature:maintain-ux:compose-primitives}]
Source example of legacy_format (object), deprecated: {provide-foundations: 'Provide foundation design tokens'}

Detector: scan the current state of wagon manifests (not only diffs). If `features` is a mapping, report it as legacy_format (deprecated). If `features` is an array, flag elements lacking `urn` or whose urn does not start with `feature:{wagon-slug}:`. The source does not state whether deprecated legacy_format fails the check or is only reported; do not treat deprecation as an immediate prohibition without a source decision.
